title: Dollar drops as weak US jobs data pushes out Fed hike expectations | Reuters
content:
U.S. Treasury yields fell sharply following the report. The ​2-year note ⁠yield, which typically moves in step with Fed rate expectations, fell 4.2 basis points to 4.245%. The yield on benchmark U.S. 10-year notes fell 2 basis points to 4.649%.

The dollar index , which measures the greenback against a ⁠basket of ​currencies including the yen and the euro, fell 0.44% to ​99.50.
